# Store#filter and Store#isFilteredItem skip soft hydration for a filterBy filter without a value

Design authority: `src/collection/Filter.mjs:115-118` (`Filter#effective`) and `src/collection/Base.mjs:1601` (`Collection#splice`), introduced in #19792 / #19796 and mirrored in `TreeStore#filter` (#20258 / PR #20259).

## Context

Promoted from defect-note (`MESSAGE:aa316289-880e-4cc4-86a3-afdf047f35f2`, observed by @neo-opus-grace while reviewing #20259).

`Neo.collection.Filter#effective` (`src/collection/Filter.mjs:115-118`) defines whether a filter actively narrows a collection:
- When a `filterBy` callback is configured, the filter is effective whenever `!this.disabled`.
- Otherwise, it is effective when `!this.disabled && this.value !== null`.

While `Collection#splice` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:1601`) and `TreeStore#filter` (#20258 / PR #20259) gate on `Filter#effective`, `Neo.data.Store` still gates its Turbo-Mode (`autoInitRecords: false`) soft-hydration passes on the pre-#19792 predicate `!f.disabled && f.value !== null`.

## The Problem

In `src/data/Store.mjs`:
1. `Store#filter()` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`) selects `activeFilters` via:
   ```javascript
   activeFilters = me.filters.filter(f => !f.disabled && f.value !== null),
   ```
2. `Store#isFilteredItem()` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`) gates per-item soft hydration via:
   ```javascript
   if (!filter.disabled && filter.value !== null) {
   ```

When a `Store` runs in Turbo Mode (`autoInitRecords: false`) with a `Model` that has complex fields (`calculate`, `convert`, or `mapping`), and an enabled `filterBy` filter declares `fields` without setting `value` (`value: null`), both `Store#filter()` and `Store#isFilteredItem()` skip soft hydration for that filter's `fields`. The `filterBy` callback then still runs inside `Filter.isFiltered()` (`src/collection/Filter.mjs:146-152`), reading `undefined` for those unhydrated fields on raw items.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Filter#effective` (`src/collection/Filter.mjs:115-118`) is the single source of authority for whether a `Filter` instance is active.
- `Store#filter()` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`) and `Store#isFilteredItem()` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`) should gate on `f.effective` / `filter.effective` so Turbo-Mode soft hydration resolves `fields` for every effective filter before `super.filter(silent)` or `super.isFilteredItem(item)` evaluates `Filter.isFiltered()`.

## The Fix

1. In `src/data/Store.mjs`:
   - Line 732 (`Store#filter`): replace `!f.disabled && f.value !== null` with `f.effective`.
   - Line 1114 (`Store#isFilteredItem`): replace `!filter.disabled && filter.value !== null` with `filter.effective`.
2. In `test/playwright/unit/data/StoreFilter.spec.mjs` (or existing `Store` unit spec):
   - Add unit test coverage verifying that in a Turbo-Mode `Store` (`autoInitRecords: false`) with a calculated model field, an enabled `filterBy` filter declaring `fields: [' doubled']` without a `value` soft-hydrates `doubled` on raw items during both `store.filter()` and `store.isFilteredItem(rawItem)`.

### Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.data.Store#filter` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`) | `Neo.collection.Filter#effective` (`src/collection/Filter.mjs:115-118`) | Selects `activeFilters` via `f => f.effective` | Inert filters (`disabled: true` or no `filterBy` and `value === null`) are skipped | JSDoc in `src/data/Store.mjs` | Playwright unit spec |
| `Neo.data.Store#isFilteredItem` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`) | `Neo.collection.Filter#effective` (`src/collection/Filter.mjs:115-118`) | Gates per-item soft hydration via `if (filter.effective)` | Inert filters are skipped | JSDoc in `src/data/Store.mjs` | Playwright unit spec |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Store#filter` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`) selects `activeFilters` using `f => f.effective`.
- [ ] `Store#isFilteredItem` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`) gates per-item soft hydration using `if (filter.effective)`.
- [ ] Unit tests verify that a Turbo-Mode `Store` (`autoInitRecords: false`) with a calculated model field soft-hydrates `fields` declared on a `filterBy` filter with `value: null` in both `filter()` and `isFilteredItem(rawItem)`.

## Out of Scope

- Modifying `Filter#effective` or `TreeStore#filter` (covered by #19792 and #20258 / PR #20259).

## Avoided Traps

- Duplicating `f.filterBy ? !f.disabled : (!f.disabled && f.value !== null)` inline in `Store.mjs` instead of delegating to `Filter#effective`.

## Related

- #19792 / PR #19796: introduced `Filter#effective` and `Filter#fields`.
- #20258 / PR #20259: fixed the same predicate in `TreeStore#filter`.
